label: preparing
what: A discreet gathering in the great hall tomorrow at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves on its four tables and installed lanterns. Watchman reports builder explicitly requested secrecy from the mayor and coordination with baker, innkeeper and freight for supply, delivery and payment. Its purpose is unknown; a celebration of my forty years of service is only speculation. Secretary and neighbour know about the lighting review, but there is insufficient evidence they knowingly help the concealed gathering.
